description: Retrieve the full text of one FirmTape document by the id `search` returned: `session:YYYY-MM-DD` for a finished trading session, `page:/path` for an explainer or research page. A FirmTape URL or a bare YYYY-MM-DD trading day is accepted too. Use when: you hold an id from `search`, or a client that only speaks search/fetch (ChatGPT). Not for: structured numbers — get_session and get_levels answer the same day with fields instead of prose. Limits: public FirmTape documents only; long pages are truncated with a link to the rest.

id.description: An id from `search`, a FirmTape URL, or a YYYY-MM-DD trading day

name: fetch
title: Fetch a FirmTape document
